referenceFunction.generalComment: Electricity domestic net production and import shares are based on annual averages for the years 2021-2023. Only gross to net electicity conversion losses are included as the power plants could not be operated without these, whereas other losses (such as transmission and distribution losses) are not included. Electricity trade between countries is included. UUID: 9997cbd5-a16e-35ca-999a-c19c68db64a4
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Included are the shares of corresponding electricity production by technology and country at the busbar. Not included are transformation, transport or distribution losses.
